name: Harmless local animal wandering
nextAction: Review in PR #308; merge only on owner instruction. No raster production requested.

context.decisionSummary: Joel requests existing non-monster animals to wander locally and remain unharmed.

decisions.proceduralDesignAcceptance: Correction authorized; revised appearance awaits feedback.

reference.exactEntityState: Existing pasture-sheep, poultry-yard, animal-pen, pup-nest props and mire-nests NPC landmark.
traitsToPreserve: Keep all original species, counts, palette, feeding/pen/nest structures and stable IDs.
Individual animals walk and rest in bounded patches; confined creatures stay within pen/nest.
Presentation time owns motion, frozen during pause; no combat targets, HP or damage callbacks.
Future sprites must animate individuals separately from the stationary composite.
